source.title: 45 Min UPPER BODY WORKOUT with DUMBBELLS | Strength Training

notes: Checked against the video: every 10 s over the whole video (title and timer), start times worked out from the timer (first work at 27 s and 1006 s confirmed second by second). The exercise name is a big title card in the 20 s before each work (top of the screen); during the work nothing names it. Three blocks, each done twice: block 1 and 2 are mixed (40 s works, a demo card then three clustered 20/20/30 s sets named only by the demo card, 30 s works), block 3 is six 40 s moves with 20 s rests (round 2 with 20 s rests, round 1 with the title taking the rest). Water breaks (60 s) and ROUND 2 cards (45 s) are rest. Moves whose name is only in the demo card of the preceding rest and could not be read are null (not scored): the two 30 s works around 1336-1403 and 1828-1896, and the last two works at 2760-2847. 0-20 s intro and the outro after 2850 s are null. Timer-based boundaries are good to about 1-2 s. No sections.
